artifact_policy: ONE current simulation, regenerated in place (atomic tmp+rename). No version chain (K2).
assumptions: independence between bets (point estimates); never load-bearing because Frechet-Hoeffding bounds (pairwise and N-way) for the same events are reported alongside
each bet's event return ~ Normal(0, sigma_event) with sigma_event taken from that artifact's own conservative K8 calibration (max of the vendor implied move read as 1 sigma vs as E|move|)
hit = 0.5 per bet is the null convention inherited from each artifact (P(non-positive)=50%); it is NOT an edge claim - the claimed edges live in each thesis file
no fat-tail overlay: Gaussian tails understate the mass of extreme earnings moves

seven bets span six distinct sessions (2026-10-01 MU; 2026-10-13 JPM + UNH; 2026-10-14 ASML; 2026-10-20 KO; 2026-10-22 TSLA; 2026-10-30 XOM): JPM and UNH both print pre-open on 2026-10-13 (the double-bill session both of those artifacts record as a risk), so those two marginals share a day - the independence point estimate ignores that positive same-day dependence and the Frechet bounds are the assumption-free bracket

sector spread: MU + ASML share the semiconductor/AI-capex factor; UNH is healthcare, TSLA consumer/EV, JPM financials, XOM energy, KO consumer staples (6 sectors across 7 bets; staples is the defensive leg) - residual cross-bet dependence is lower than a same-sector book but is still not assumed zero
disclaimer: Research/ops artifact for internal scorekeeping. Not financial advice.
limitations: n=7 bets: these are reproducible consequences of seven committed calibrations, not a measured distribution over a sample (K3 honesty - no hit rate is claimed until horizons score)
Gaussian event returns: real earnings returns are fat-tailed, so tail numbers like P(all miss) are likely understated; the Frechet bounds are the assumption-free fallback
sigma_event inputs inherit each vendor implied-move quote's convention risk (documented in each thesis artifact)
the MC leg validates arithmetic only - it carries no information beyond the analytic result (V7/V9)
cross-bet correlation in reality is not zero - and JPM/UNH share the 2026-10-13 session outright; pairwise and N-way bounds bracket it, the point estimate assumes independence

the per-cell MC gate uses a 4.5-SE family-wise bound over the ~2187 simultaneous cell tests (3^7; a naive 3-SE per-cell gate fails by chance alone at this cell count); margins keep 3 SE - the MC leg still validates arithmetic only, no information beyond the analytic result
simulation is prospective: all seven outcomes are unscored until their horizons (2026-10-01, 2026-10-13, 2026-10-14, 2026-10-20, 2026-10-22, 2026-10-30) with sourced quotes

negative_controls.check: V2 catches a planted +1% band (k no longer matches the artifact)
V9 digest is seed-sensitive (seed+1 gives a different digest)
V3 catches a planted +5% sigma_event (probabilities diverge)

purpose: quantify the joint event risk of the registered bet book before any horizon arrives; read-only simulation, no new market numbers, no trades, no recommendations
revision_note: extended from 6 registered bets to all 7 (MU, UNH, ASML, TSLA, JPM, XOM, KO) after the KO (TASK-00137) registration; the 'not yet in the joint simulation' limitation the KO artifact recorded is closed by this run (JPM TASK-00115 and XOM TASK-00125 gaps were closed earlier); the per-cell MC gate remains a 4.5-SE family-wise bound because 2187 simultaneous cell tests make a naive 3-SE per-cell gate fail by chance alone

validation.check: all inputs parse as market-thesis-active.v1 with sha256 recorded
k == band/sigma_event matches each artifact's stated k (1e-9)
recomputed analytic p matches each artifact (1e-9)
joint sums to 1 and every axis marginal equals its analytic
every joint cell == product of per-bet analytics (independence)
MC margins within 3.0 SE and all 2187 joint cells within 4.5 SE of analytic (n=200000; family-wise cell bound)
independence estimates lie inside the Frechet bounds (pairwise and N-way)
MC is deterministic for a fixed seed (digest matches on re-run)
all horizons are after the run date (sim is prospective, unscored)
